name: 33311 · Ft Lauderdale, FL
findings: ZIP 33311 (Ft Lauderdale) has 362 nonprofit organizations. 101 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 82 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33311 (Ft Lauderdale) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
72% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 38 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
